scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/refcheck build && bun run --cwd packages/frontmatter-lint build && bun run --cwd packages/semble-sync build && bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/tui build
scripts.test:fast: bun run --cwd packages/refcheck test && bun run --cwd packages/frontmatter-lint test && bun run --cwd packages/semble-sync test && bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/cli test && bun run --cwd packages/tui test
scripts.test:full: bun run test:fast && bun run --cwd packages/web test && bun run --cwd extensions/clipper test
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd packages/refcheck build && bun run --cwd packages/frontmatter-lint build && bun run --cwd packages/semble-sync build && bun run --cwd packages/refcheck lint && bun run --cwd packages/frontmatter-lint lint && bun run --cwd packages/semble-sync lint && bun run --cwd packages/core lint && bun run --cwd packages/cli lint
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist extensions/clipper/dist extensions/clipper/dist-chrome extensions/clipper/*.zip packages/web/tests/screenshots
scripts.web: bun run packages/web/server.ts & sleep 1 && bun run --cwd packages/web dev
